coverage.reason: Supplied clause is interpreted for the selected net-assets calculation.

dimensions.explanation: The clause defines the selected net-assets calculation; no broader actor or whole-bank compliance scope is stated.
The clause defines “net assets” as total assets minus total liabilities and defines “net assets, excluding primary residence” as net assets minus the value of the primary residence.
“Excluding primary residence” is an attached deduction in the second definition; the source does not state any further exception or exclusion rule.
The text is definitional (“refers to”), with no separate duty, permission, prohibition, or discretion.
The supplied clause contains no effective date or assessment date; the retained-edition and synthetic timestamp conditions are external task context.
The calculation depends on classified total assets, classified total liabilities, and the primary-residence value, with the latter already included in assets as specified by the input definitions.

assumptions: Input classification, account ownership, and conversion to HKD cents are supplied.
The residence value is already included in total assets.
Signed input amounts are admitted for arithmetic stress tests.

citations.quote: 3.3 “Net assets” refers to the value that is calculated by deducting total liabilities from total assets. “Net assets, excluding primary residence” refers to the value that is calculated by deducting the value of primary residence from net assets.

readings.distinction: The primary residence deduction is applied after computing net assets, so it is deducted once from total assets minus total liabilities.
